name: Meena S.
headline: Got all 9 certificates in 18 days — without a single agent fee
summary: After my husband passed away, I had no idea how to claim his pension or transfer the property. PaperTrail AI gave me a step-by-step plan. I handled everything myself, saved ₹12,000 in agent fees, and every office visit was exactly what they said it would be.

name: Rajkumar P.
headline: Property mutation done in 3 weeks — RTI draft helped when they delayed
summary: The tahsildar's office kept giving excuses. PaperTrail AI generated an RTI application citing the Right to Services Act. Within 48 hours of posting it, my patta was updated. I didn't even have to send it — just showing the draft was enough.

name: Lakshmi V.
headline: Name change across 5 departments completed in one month
summary: Marriage name change requires updating Aadhaar, PAN, bank accounts, and more. PaperTrail AI listed all 7 places I needed to update, in the right order, with the exact form numbers. My bank even accepted the auto-filled form without asking for corrections.

name: Suresh M.
headline: Family pension transferred in 28 days — even after initial rejection
summary: The pension office rejected my mother's application twice. PaperTrail AI identified the exact missing documents each time and explained why in simple Tamil. The third submission was accepted the same day. We didn't need a lawyer.

name: Priya N.
headline: Birth certificate and school admission documents ready in 10 days
summary: We needed a birth certificate for our daughter's school admission and had a tight deadline. PaperTrail AI showed exactly which office, which counter, and what copies to carry. We were done in 2 visits.

name: Anbu K.
headline: Navigated 11 procedures in 45 days — first in our village to do it without a middleman
summary: When my father passed away he had land, a post office account, and a government pension. Nobody in our village knew how to handle all three without paying an agent thousands. PaperTrail AI walked us through it in Tamil, step by step.
